user_saw: The macOS welcome flow could not load connection options: openclaw.setup.detect returned UNAVAILABLE with 'No supported SQLite library for Bun on macOS' even though the bundled Bun Gateway was ready.
summary: Read-only SQLite subprocess launchers now add the Bun-on-macOS selected library path (OPENCLAW_SQLITE_LIBRARY) to the projected child environment.
reasoning: Per issue #203124 and PR #203177, state metadata reads pass a reduced worker environment ({OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR, ...} from openclaw-state-worker-context.capture.ts) to the read-only worker, which has used caller env since September (blame 71a1d0d2060/a06612710e6); the child then re-runs SQLite selection without the env-only library path. That code worked for Node and for Homebrew-discovered libraries (fixed paths), and broke only once the library came solely from OPENCLAW_SQLITE_LIBRARY, as in the macOS app's bundled Bun runtime; I found no single commit that removed a previously working handoff despite the 'restore' title, so I classify it as latent with no identified trigger (an alternative reading is never-worked from 757e482ab646, which added the env override and forwarded it only to the KNN child).
